title: Impact of vitamin D supplementation on all-cause mortality: Randomized ...
text: Impact of vitamin D supplementation on all-cause mortality: Randomized .... Vitamin D insufficiency and deficiency are common worldwide and linked to adverse health outcomes, including higher all-cause mortality. Two large randomized controlled trials (VITAL and D-Health), conducted in mostly vitamin D-sufficient populations, found no mortality benefits of vitamin D supplementation.
